a column declared in the data contract is absent from the table header
the data table file declared in [[data.contract]] does not exist
a data row has a blank identifier in the declared id_column
an Ensembl ID column mixes versioned and unversioned identifiers
the table mixes different missing-value tokens (such as NA, NaN, and empty)
a declared sample matrix has no sample columns
an adjusted p-value is smaller than its corresponding raw p-value
a p-value cell is outside [0, 1] or not a finite number
a p-value is recorded as exact 0 (possible numerical underflow)
a gene symbol is a previous HGNC symbol rather than the approved symbol
a raw-count cell is negative or not an integer
the declared data table is a symbolic link or has extra hard links
a gene symbol is a withdrawn HGNC symbol
a data row has a different number of columns than the header
a sample in the linked sample sheet has no column in this matrix
a sample column in this matrix is absent from the linked sample sheet
the sample order in the matrix differs from the linked sample sheet
the study record linked by this data contract could not be safely read
a gene symbol's casing disagrees with the linked study's declared species
a cell value does not match the column's declared data type
the declared data table could not be read or changed during the check

rules.fix: inspect the reported row and column, then correct the export or the declared table contract
rules.name: data.contracts
rules.pass_does_not_mean: That every identifier is current or that any scientific conclusion follows.
rules.why: Table exports can silently change identifiers, values or sample labels.

rules.checks: Advisory: each shadow stage has a current comparison tied to two successful recorded runs and their unchanged outputs.

codes.fix: a saved shadow-stage comparison record could not be parsed or failed validation
a declared shadow stage has no recorded comparison yet
a shadow-stage comparison no longer matches its recorded runs or outputs

rules.fix: keep both recorded outputs and run steward compare record with the shadow stage name
rules.name: compare.shadow
rules.pass_does_not_mean: That the methods are interchangeable or that the owner approved the switch.
rules.why: Review agreement and every disagreement before using the candidate.

rules.checks: Every accession recorded by a study that lists the paper appears in the paper's data-availability statement: the file its spec names (data_availability), else the section under a 'Data availability' heading in its sources.

codes.fix: an accession from a cited study is missing from the paper's data-availability statement
no data-availability file or section was found for the paper
the declared data-availability file is a link or outside the repository

rules.fix: name every accession of the cited studies in the paper's data-availability statement
rules.name: paper.data_availability
rules.pass_does_not_mean: That the accessions are public, or that the statement is complete beyond the recorded studies.
rules.why: Journals and reviewers check that every dataset used is named; a missing accession is found late, by someone else.

rules.checks: Model weights and training study fingerprints, the declared weights licence expression, and exact card metrics from a successful run on the recorded weights, contract and current splits.

codes.fix: Keep the model configuration in a regular file
the model record's evaluation split is not defined in its benchmark contract
Keep one record per model name and version
a model evaluation run's input file changed after the recorded run
Use an SPDX licence expression for the weights
a recorded model-card metric disagrees with the evaluation run's output
a model-card metric is not declared in the benchmark contract
the referenced evaluation run did not record metric values
the referenced evaluation run does not match the model weights or split context
Keep an intact run ledger for this project
Use a run with one successful outcome
a split file referenced by the model's benchmark contract is missing or unreadable
a training study's input file changed since the model record was written
a training study named in the model record does not exist or failed checks
the model weights file is missing or differs from its recorded SHA-256

rules.fix: check the weights and training studies, then record a current evaluation run and use its metric values
rules.name: model.records
rules.pass_does_not_mean: Scientific validity, proof of training, or permission to distribute the weights.
rules.why: A model's recorded metrics can become stale when weights or benchmark splits change.

rules.checks: Advisory: with [stranger_test] declared, a stranger-test record (development/assessment/DATE-stranger-test-TAG-AGENT.md) not older than max_age_days.

codes.fix: a stranger-test file was ignored because it was empty or dated in the future
no stranger-test record was found under development/assessment/
the latest stranger-test record is older than [stranger_test] max_age_days

rules.fix: run a stranger test on the coming release: steward stranger-test brief --tag TAG --for AGENT
rules.name: release.stranger_test
rules.pass_does_not_mean: That the project is useful: the record says what one stranger met.
rules.why: Whether a newcomer can get value from a release is found by trying it, from the outside, before the release; the project's own developers cannot see it any more.

rules.checks: Advisory: with [tidy] declared, the counts of steward tidy from the repository's records: open board tasks untouched for stale_days, board statuses a sprint ledger contradicts, own exchange items still open after their response, a handoff older than handoff_days or a state page naming no version as recent as the latest tag, received items not acknowledged in time, merged sprint branches and worktrees.

codes.fix: a task's board status contradicts what a sprint ledger recorded
an exchange item is still open after a response or awaiting acknowledgement
a merged sprint branch or worktree is still present in the repository
a handoff or index page is older than its threshold or behind the latest tag
an open task on the board has been untouched longer than stale_days

rules.fix: run steward tidy, then ask the owner whether to archive, delete or keep each item
rules.name: tidy.stale
rules.pass_does_not_mean: That a listed item should go: nothing is archived or deleted unless the owner asks. Memory folders and the peers' checkouts are outside the repository: steward tidy lists them.
rules.why: Stale tasks and pages cost attention, and for agents tokens, at every session; naming them lets the owner archive, delete or keep each one.

rules.checks: Advisory: with [delegation] declared, each agent it names (the master and every worker) is installed: its CLI is on PATH or in its known install folder. Nothing is run.

codes.fix: an agent configured under [delegation] is not installed on PATH or in its install folder

rules.fix: install the agent named, or run steward agents setup to write a [delegation] of the installed agents
rules.name: delegation.installed
rules.pass_does_not_mean: That the agent is signed in or within its usage limits: steward agents status shows what the availability ledger recorded.
rules.why: A delegated task given to an agent that is not installed fails before it starts, and the master learns it only then.
